# <span id="aanchor293"></span> Item Deprecation

<a href="#" class="selected">Deprecated for Current Release</a> \| [Future Deprecation](Item%20Deprecation_Future.md) \| [Deprecation History](Item%20Deprecation_History.md)

## Deprecated as of 10.1.0.0

The following items have been deprecated as of Version 10.1.0.0. If your company requires any of the following items, please contact <a href="mailto:flowcal.support@quorumsoftware.com" class="InlineLink">Customer Support</a> immediately.

> #### Location Rollups Viewers
>
> With the release of the new Balance Explorer, the Daily Location Rollups, Monthly Location Rollups, NGL Balance, and Recovery Balance Viewers will be removed.
>

> #### Location Close Approval from Exception Resolver
>
> Selecting location exceptions now opens the Balance Explorer, at the request of the FLOWCAL user community.
>
> <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Location Close Approval">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Show Details</a>
>
> <div style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Location Close Approval">
>
> |  |  |
> |:---|:---|
> | Reason | Selecting a location exception in the Exception Resolver opens the Location Close Approval screen. With the launch of our new Balance Explorer, selecting location exceptions opens the Balance Explorer, at the request of the FLOWCAL user community. |
> | Replaced by Another Feature | The Exception Resolver will now open the new Balance Explorer for location exceptions. |
> | Items Affected | Selecting a location exception from the Exception Resolver will no longer open the Location Close Approval screen; however, the Location Close Approval screen can still be accessed from the main menu. |
> | Installation Changes | N/A |
> | Upgrade Changes | N/A |
>
> </div>
>

> #### Import Drivers
>
> LQTicket.dll has been removed from the installer.
>
> <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Import Drivers">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Show Details</a>
>
> <div style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Import Drivers">
>
> |  |  |
> |:---|:---|
> | Reason | Custom import drivers are not included in the general install set. For this reason, LQTicket.dll has been removed from the installer. |
> | Replaced by Another Feature | Yes, the FLOWCAL now supports a standard text file format for importing liquid data. |
> | Items Affected | LQTicket.dll import driver |
> | Installation Changes | Driver listed will not be present |
> | Upgrade Changes | Customers must confirm if import driver is in use before upgrading. If your company is using this driver, please contact [Flow-Cal Support](mailto:flowcal.support@quorumsoftware.com). |
>
> </div>
>
